# Queen's University

> A leading Canadian research-intensive university offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs with global impact in innovation and sustainability.

Queen's University is a top-tier institution in Kingston, Ontario, known for research excellence across disciplines including engineering, business, education, and science. The university emphasizes student experience, community engagement, and international collaboration through its diverse academic offerings and vibrant campus life.
